# `multimodal_to_header`

Detects image and audio content in message arrays and promotes a routing fact.

## Configuration Notes

Detection covers typed OpenAI content parts (`image_url`, `input_image`, `input_audio`, `audio_url`), image/audio data URLs, and base64 sources with an image or audio media type. Text-only or malformed bodies do not publish a modality fact.

The filter removes a client-supplied copy of its output header before publishing `image`, `audio`, or `image_audio`. A following core `router` can exact-match those values to keep multimodal content away from text-only backends.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `header` | string | no | Header that receives the detected modality. |
| `max_body_bytes` | integer | no | Maximum JSON request body buffered for detection. |

## Example

```yaml
filter: multimodal_to_header
header: X-Praxis-AI-Modality
max_body_bytes: 1048576
```
